parsed.explanation: Assuming all symbols a_i,b_i are distinct, the family E_i={a_1,...,a_i,b_i} is pairwise intersecting because every E_i contains a_1, and E_1={a_1,b_1} has size 2. For every k≥1, {b_1,...,b_k,a_{k+1}} is a transversal: it meets E_i via b_i for i≤k and via a_{k+1} for i≥k+1. It is inclusion-minimal, since deleting b_i leaves E_i unhit, while deleting a_{k+1} leaves E_{k+1} unhit. Thus there are infinitely many minimal finite transversals. The quoted blocker fact and therefore the stated finite-transversal lemma are false. No later argument independently establishes the required finiteness, so the periodicity proof is invalid as written.
